lines.speaker: Marsh
lines.text: My brother tells me you're Mistborn. That's rarer than he's letting on, and more dangerous than he's letting on too.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: He didn't mention the dangerous part.

lines.speaker: Marsh
lines.text: He wouldn't. Learn fast, and learn who to trust slower than that. It's kept me alive this long.
